Lieutenant Governor Flags Off Budha Amarnath Yatra Amid Security

Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha flagged off the Budha Amarnath Ji Yatra from Jammu. The first batch of pilgrims departed under tight security arrangements. The yatra's inauguration ceremony was addressed by the Lieutenant Governor.
